hero.title: Your business. All in one place.
hero.subtitle: Messages, customers, orders, payments, stock and delivery — one connected flow instead of six disconnected apps.
hero.demoMessage: Do you have the black one in M?

problem.title: Six tools. One lost customer.
problem.body: A message arrives on Facebook. The payment lands in a bank app. Delivery lives in a courier chat. The record ends in a notebook. Nothing talks to anything.
problem.result: APSA joins them into one line.

inbox.title: Every channel in one inbox
inbox.body: Facebook, Instagram and Telegram in a single list, with follow-up status on every conversation so nothing goes quiet by accident.

flow.title: Message to order in four taps
flow.body: The customer is already filled in. Pick the product, pick the variant, create the order. The thread records it for you.

ops.title: Orders, payment, delivery
ops.ordersBody: One order, one full story — items, staff, timeline.
ops.paymentBody: Cash, KHQR or transfer. Marked paid by a human, never guessed.
ops.deliveryBody: Courier, tracking and COD amount tracked to the door.

history.title: History that prevents wrong orders
history.body: Every customer carries their sizes, their address, their last purchase and their notes — so the second order is easier than the first.

cambodia.title: Built for Cambodia
cambodia.khqrBody: The payment method your customers already use.
cambodia.currencyBody: Both currencies, riel rounded to the nearest 100.
cambodia.couriersBody: J&T, VET, Capital and Grab Express.
cambodia.khmerBody: Khmer is the default language, not an afterthought.

cta.title: Never lose a customer, message, order, payment or follow-up again.
cta.body: Set up your shop in minutes. No card, no contract.

apsi.title: You replied to 26 messages today.
apsi.body: That's your best day this week. Three follow-ups are still waiting.

empty.title: Today is quiet
empty.body: No orders yet. Your first sale will show up here.

error.title: Today's numbers didn't load
error.body: The data didn't come back. Check your connection and try again.

design.title: APSA design system
design.subtitle: Tokens, type, and every component in every state. Reviewed before screens.
design.sheetBody: Drag the handle, press Escape, or tap the scrim to close.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.body: When something arrives, it shows up in this list.

error.title: This didn't load
error.body: The data didn't come back. Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: No conversations here
empty.body: Change the filter, or wait for the next message to arrive.

emptySearch.title: No matches
emptySearch.body: Nothing matched that search. Try a name, phone number or word from the message.

error.title: The inbox didn't load
error.body: Your conversations didn't come back. Check your connection and try again.

comments.title: Comments are coming
comments.body: Post comments will land in this tab so you can reply without leaving APSA.

selectPrompt.title: Pick a conversation
selectPrompt.body: Choose someone on the left and the thread opens here.

empty.title: No messages yet
empty.body: When this customer writes, the thread starts here.

error.title: This conversation didn't load
error.body: The thread didn't come back. Check your connection and try again.

saved.greeting: Hello! How can I help you today?
saved.stock: Yes, that one is in stock.
saved.delivery: Delivery to Phnom Penh is $0.90 and arrives today.

customerUnavailable.title: Customer details unavailable
customerUnavailable.body: The customer record didn't load, so ordering is paused.

createOrder.title: Create order
createOrder.createdBody: It's on the thread and waiting for payment.

error.title: The order wasn't created
error.body: Nothing was saved. Try creating it again.

permission.title: You can't approve this order
permission.body: Orders above $500 need an owner. Ask the shop owner to create it.

pos.title: Point of sale

cash.shortfall: Cash received is less than the total.

pos.manualConfirm: Confirm the transfer on your bank app, then mark the sale as paid.
pos.codNote: Payment is collected on delivery. The sale stays pending until paid.
pos.offline: You are offline. Sales cannot be completed until the connection returns.

empty.title: Cart is empty
empty.body: Add products to start a sale.

cart.clearConfirmTitle: Clear all items from this cart?

discount.label: Discount
discount.approval: This discount is above the cashier limit and needs manager approval.

empty.title: No customer found
empty.body: Try another name or phone number, or create a new customer.

empty.title: No products yet
empty.body: Add products to your catalogue to start selling.

noResults.title: No matching products
noResults.body: Try a different name, SKU or barcode.

success.title: Sale complete
success.codNote: Collect payment when the order is delivered.

order.title: Order
order.notFoundBody: This order no longer exists or was moved.
order.deniedBody: Ask the shop owner for permission to view this order.
order.noDeliveryBody: This order is collected in store or has no courier yet.
order.customerMissingBody: The customer for this order was removed. Money and items are still shown.
order.codNote: Cash on delivery — the courier still holds this money.

returnSheet.title: Start a return
returnSheet.body: A return moves goods back. It does not send money back.

refundSheet.title: Refund money
refundSheet.body: A refund moves money. It does not assume the goods came back.
refundSheet.invalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.

paymentSheet.title: Record payment
paymentSheet.body: You are confirming money you already received. APSA does not check with the bank.

deliverySheet.title: Arrange delivery
deliverySheet.body: Choose a courier. APSA records it for you — no courier is contacted.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.notFoundBody: This delivery no longer exists or was moved.
delivery.deniedBody: Ask the shop owner for permission to view deliveries.
delivery.settlementPending: Settlement pending — the money is not in your account yet
